name: security-android-deeplink-auth-binding-review
intent: Android deep-link transaction and authenticated action binding
artifacts: Link handler, account/session state, pending action storage and confirmation/authorization gate.
trace: Trace external link fields into account selection and sensitive operations, including links opened before login and replayed after account changes.
experiment: Use a local app/test account fixture and benign action; compare an intended link with another owned account/transaction identifier.
disproof: Opening a screen is not execution of a protected action; a required confirmation may already enforce the intended policy.
repair: Bind pending action to current identity and transaction, retesting login transitions, replay and legitimate navigation.
branch_decisions: Resolve the receiving component and parse route parameters before identifying the authenticated consumer. Authentication of the app user does not authorize every link-selected object or action. A link that merely opens a confirmation screen is not a committed action; compare the final server transaction and any one-time nonce/account binding.
